entries.364218774745b69d: This is a business model in which the company develops, manufactures and sells, as a system, onboard equipment such as fare boxes and the settlement devices at operating offices, matched to the fare collection methods of each bus operator, and also handles maintenance.
entries.37169209893b24e9: This category covers fare boxes, fare box safes and fare box software, which are the company's main products. Fare boxes include instant-counting fare boxes, which calculate the fare from the barcode on a ticket or the ride information on a card, instantly count the fare deposited and settle it automatically, and general-purpose fare boxes, in which crew members visually check the fare. This also includes fare boxes for one-man railway operation and gate-type fare boxes.
entries.39ddc1e0d60b780d: The Business Overview states that after a transaction relationship with users is built through bus fare boxes, it can develop into transactions in card-related products and other bus equipment, and that this holds an important position in business strategy as well as in results.
entries.42de04e98cf8d648: ODAWARA AUTO-MACHINE MFG.CO.,LTD. is headquartered in Odawara City, Kanagawa Prefecture, and forms a group with three consolidated subsidiaries. The number of employees as of December 31, 2025 was 224.
entries.45193059d8198529: It has formulated a new medium-term management plan (ＯＮＧ2030) for fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2030, and aims to keep running its growth cycle of 'enhancing earning power', 'executing growth investment' and 'achieving sales growth'. Its key measures include shifting from seiban-based make-to-order production to MRP-based production using demand forecasts and standard specifications; strengthening its lineup of fare collection equipment and multi-payment terminals and creating new business areas such as data service solutions; and expanding its share in its core domain by winning orders for the large-scale replacement demand for fare collection equipment planned in the Tokyo metropolitan area.

entries.85119b5763758a88: Fare collection equipment, including fare boxes, must be customized to fare collection methods that differ by bus operator and to harsh operating conditions such as vibration, dust and temperature differences, so it has established a development structure that streamlines development by defining "common specifications" and customizes through "individual specifications," allowing it to efficiently provide products that match the specifications customers require. It developed the instant-counting fare box ahead of other companies in 1986 as the instant-counting fare box FA type.
